expected_symptom: myTexture.Sample(SamplerDescriptorHeap[i], coord) -- the SM 6.6 Dynamic Resources spec sample -- is rejected with 'no matching member function for call to Sample' plus notes that only discuss argument count, on a build that does have SM 6.6 dynamic resources.
summary: Still reproduces on main (13730886e, 1.9.0.5433) and on all 18 stable releases from v1.6.2104 to v1.9.2607 -- 19/19 of the builds that have SM 6.6 dynamic resources, established per release by a feature-presence control whose DXIL must declare both descriptor-heap feature flags and contain dx.op.createHandleFromHeap, not merely exit 0. Only v1.4.1907 and v1.5.2010 are invalid probes (no ps_6_6). Scope is wider than the title: all 8 sampler-taking texture intrinsic methods (Sample, SampleLevel, SampleBias, SampleGrad, SampleCmp, SampleCmpLevelZero, GatherRed, CalculateLevelOfDetail) reject an inline heap subscript and compile it hoisted into a local, SamplerComparisonState included, so it is not a SamplerState/SamplerComparisonState confusion. The implicit conversion doubted in the 2024-07-25 comment does exist: CanConvert has an explicit heap-to-object case (SemaHLSL.cpp:10353) that initialisation, casts and user-defined function arguments all use, compiling on 19/19; intrinsic arguments instead go through MatchArguments, which for an object argument ends at CombineObjectTypes(AR_OBJECT_SAMPLER, AR_OBJECT_HEAP_SAMPLER) (SemaHLSL.cpp:7354; g_SamplerCT at :1156), and that function has no case for either heap kind (:6765), so the candidate is dropped and only the generic overload error and arity notes reach the user. No test under tools/clang/test/ covers the uncast inline form in either direction -- every existing SamplerDescriptorHeap test hoists, and the one inline test casts. The documentation half of the 2024 plan is done (DirectX-Specs#191 merged 2024-09-04, sample removed); the Clang half is not yet testable -- hlsl_clang_trunk reports 'use of undeclared identifier ResourceDescriptorHeap' for the repro and for the workaround alike, while a trivial Texture2D/SamplerState shader compiles there.
text_stale: Body premise, through no fault of the reporter. The body opens 'The following is a sample from this document' and quotes the SM 6.6 Dynamic Resources spec, but that sample was removed by microsoft/DirectX-Specs#191 (merged 2024-09-04); the page now says the subscript must be used to assign a variable or a function call argument, and its example hoists. A reader who checks the premise today finds no such sample and can reasonably read the doc change as having resolved the issue. It did not: the compiler behaviour is unchanged on 13730886e and on 19/19 probeable builds.
title: SamplerDescriptorHeap[sampIdx] cannot be used inside of texture.Sample(...)
